verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents an API with more than 120 actions, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable machine-readable spec, and probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The llms.txt file and the MCP server are different capabilities and do not count as an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
